Title: Vihaan's Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anjali - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Suresh - 43 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Vimla - 67 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Vihaan stands in the bedroom. Anjali, Suresh and Vimla stand near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan yawns loudly.]

Vimla (surprised): "Suresh, are you okay?"

[Vihaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Vihaan (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Vihaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Vihaan: "Show me too!"

[Vihaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Vihaan: "Really?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Vihaan, look over here."

[Vihaan lights a diya.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vihaan paints a picture.]

Vihaan: "What a day to remember!"
